Bakerloo.reason: BAKERLOO LINE: Saturday 21 and Sunday 22 November, no service between Queens Park and Harrow & Wealdstone. Please note that special bus service 718 will NOT operate. There will also be no LIONESS LINE service between Euston and Watford Junction. LONDON NORTH WESTERN RAILWAY trains continue to stop at Harrow & Wealdstone. SOUTHERN trains stop at Wembley Central and Harrow & Wealdstone until 1900 Saturday only, not on Sunday.

District.reason: TUBE STRIKE: Piccadilly line service control staff are taking strike action from Friday 20 until Saturday evening, 21 November. Due to shared infrastructure around the Ealing Common District line depot, there will be no DISTRICT LINE service between Turnham Green and Ealing Broadway from midday on Friday until Saturday evening, with a reduced service on the rest of the line. No Piccadilly line service is expected during the strike. Replacement bus services operate during Friday Night Tube and Saturday daytime hours only. Please use MILDMAY LINE services between Gunnersbury, Kew Gardens and Richmond, where available.

DLR.reason: DOCKLANDS LIGHT RAILWAY: Saturday 21 and Sunday 22 November, no service between Canning Town and Stratford International. Please use JUBILEE LINE and local London Buses services.

Hammersmith & City.reason: Hammersmith and City Line: Severe delays due to train cancellations. Tickets will be accepted on C2C, and local bus services.

Lioness.reason: LIONESS LINE: Saturday 21 and Sunday 22 November, no service between Euston and Watford Junction. There will also be no BAKERLOO LINE service between Queens Park and Harrow & Wealdstone. Special bus service 720 operates (please note service 718 will NOT operate). LONDON NORTH WESTERN RAILWAY trains continue to serve Euston, Harrow & Wealdstone, Bushey and Watford Junction. SOUTHERN trains serve Wembley Central, Harrow & Wealdstone and Watford Junction until 1900 Saturday only, not on Sunday.

Piccadilly.reason: TUBE STRIKE: Piccadilly line service control staff are planning to take strike action from Friday 20 until Saturday evening 21 November. There will be no service from midday on Friday until Saturday evening, including Night Tube on Friday night. Normal Night Tube service is expected to operate on Saturday night. Due to shared infrastructure around the Ealing Common District line depot, there will be no DISTRICT LINE service between Turnham Green and Ealing Broadway from midday on Friday until Saturday evening. Replacement buses will operate during Friday Night Tube hours and Saturday daytime only. Please use ELIZABETH LINE services for travel between Central London and Heathrow, and between terminals, and METROPOLITAN LINE services between Rayners Lane and Uxbridge.

Victoria.reason: Victoria Line: Minor delays due to train cancellations.

Waterloo & City.reason: Waterloo & City line: service operates 06:00 until 00:30, Monday to Friday only. There is no service on Saturdays, Sundays and on bank/public holidays.
